# Nebula Ideas

Website: https://nebulaideas.com

Nebula Ideas helps organizations identify the value AI can create, uncover what should improve before automation, and build a clear path forward.

We believe AI is an amplifier. The best outcomes emerge when people, context, and technology work together.

## Hero

AI is an amplifier.

Understand before you amplify.

Work with AI. Not around it.

---

## The Nebula Clarity Sprint

Understand before you decide.

The Nebula Clarity Sprint helps organizations understand their current reality, identify friction, and uncover practical opportunities for AI, automation, and operational improvement before investing in a solution.

What we seek to understand:

- Context and objectives
- Ways of working
- Technology and constraints
- AI and automation opportunities

What you'll gain:

- A clear view of the current situation
- Key risks and points of friction
- Prioritized opportunities
- Practical recommendations for next steps
- Guidance on AI and automation
- An initial action plan

---

## Beyond the Clarity Sprint

Clarity is not the destination. It's the beginning.

The Clarity Sprint creates a shared understanding of your current reality, opportunities, and constraints.

What comes next depends on what we discover together.

### AI & Automation Strategy

Clarity on where AI can create meaningful value.

### Architecture & Technical Assessment

A better understanding of the constraints, risks, and opportunities within your systems.

### Product & Process Alignment

Business goals, teams, and technology moving in the same direction.

### Engineering Leadership & Advisory

Greater confidence in technical and organizational decision-making.

## Who We Are

Nebula Ideas is a two-partner engineering advisory firm based in León, Guanajuato, Mexico. We work remotely with companies across Mexico and the United States, in English and Spanish.

- Ismael Marin — Co-Founder, AI Infrastructure & Tooling. Software engineer and tech lead. Website: https://ismaelmarin.dev · GitHub: https://github.com/igmarin
- Carlos (Mumo) Muniz — Managing Partner, Engineering & Delivery. Staff-level engineer and team architect. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/mumoc

We have worked together since 2014.

## Verified Open-Source Work

We build the tools we recommend. Every project is public, versioned, and independently verifiable.

- rails-ai-bridge — Rails context and read-only introspection for AI coding assistants. 11,000+ RubyGems downloads. https://rubygems.org/gems/rails-ai-bridge
- ruby-skill-bench — Measures whether added context improves an agent's work. 3,000+ RubyGems downloads. https://rubygems.org/gems/ruby-skill-bench
- rs-guard — Rust CLI for multi-provider AI code review in GitHub pull requests. Published Rust crate (archived). https://docs.rs/rs-guard

## FAQ

### What is the Nebula Clarity Sprint?

The Nebula Clarity Sprint helps organizations understand their current reality, identify friction, and uncover practical opportunities for AI, automation, and operational improvement before investing in a solution.

### How long does the Clarity Sprint take?

The Clarity Sprint is designed to be efficient and focused. It is generally completed in 1–2 weeks, depending on the complexity and scope of the organization.

### What deliverables do I receive?

You receive a clear view of the current situation, key risks and points of friction, prioritized opportunities, practical recommendations for next steps, guidance on AI and automation, and an initial action plan.

### Do you work with organizations outside Mexico?

Yes, we work with companies in both Mexico and the United States. Our team is bilingual and can provide services in English and Spanish.
